goal: Use Lark private-message task coaching to learn employee onboarding friction, distill governed insight candidates, route them through Obsidian review, and expose management dashboard metrics without allowing unapproved feedback to modify runtime behavior.

acceptance_criteria.description: The employee insight loop contract remains valid, has unique acceptance criteria, documents runtime surfaces, and records closed-loop safety boundaries.
Lark private messages can create employee insight sessions with lark_dm channel, employee identity, department, scenario, and outreach_frequency_limit metadata.
Each outreach session supports opt_out, pause, skip, failed, engaged, blocked, and completed states, and illegal state transitions are rejected.

Pilot employee profiles persist employee_hash, department, role, pilot_status, preferred_touch_time, last_outreach_at, and unanswered_outreach_count without requiring plaintext employee rosters in config.

The outreach scheduler plans lark_dm proactive outreach only for active pilots, enforces one outreach per day, applies a three-day cooldown after two unanswered outreaches, and records outreach_sent sessions, events, and audit entries without performing direct message sending inside dashboard refresh paths.

The outreach dispatcher defaults to dry-run, never calls a real sender during dashboard refresh, requires approved=true for real sends, records send failures as audit events without marking outreach as sent, and exposes dashboard dispatch as dry-run until a real sender is explicitly configured.
Employee coaching stores structured employee_insight_events instead of treating raw chat text as the only data model.
Harness distillation creates review_required insight candidates for needs, templates, skills, router improvements, knowledge gaps, onboarding fixes, and Hermes deep dives.
Unapproved candidates are approved-only blocked and must not modify router, must not auto-publish skill, must not write production knowledge, and must not change AstrBot runtime prompts.
Candidate notes export to Obsidian with stable insight_id, review_status mapped to need_review, candidate_type, source evidence, sensitivity, and governance_version.
Dashboard snapshots expose outreach, effective conversations, completed sessions, blocked sessions, top scenarios, friction points, pending approvals, and released improvements.
Repeated multi-employee or cross-department candidates can create Hermes deep-dive task payloads, but Hermes output must return to harness and Obsidian review before runtime changes.
Every session, candidate, governance export, approval, release, rollback, and validation transition writes append-only audit events.
The employee-facing first version excludes employee WebUI, employee task center, mass all-company outreach, and unreviewed self-learning release.

runtime_policy.outreach_frequency_limit: At most one proactive private-message outreach per active pilot employee per day; reduce to every three days after two unanswered outreaches.
runtime_policy.opt_out: Employees can reply pause, later, stop, or exit equivalents to pause or exit pilot outreach.
runtime_policy.save_policy: Structured events and short summaries may be stored; full chat archives follow lark_chat_memory_watermarks and are not default LLM prompt context.
runtime_policy.governance_policy: All distillation outputs default to review_required and are blocked from runtime mutation until approved in Obsidian.
runtime_policy.release_policy: Approved runtime patches start with pilot rollout scope and append-only audit. Router and skill changes require tests before release.

non_goals: Do not build an employee WebUI or employee task center in the first version.
Do not implement all-company proactive outreach before pilot metrics and opt-out handling are proven.
Do not let unreviewed employee feedback change production router rules.
Do not auto-publish skill from employee feedback or Hermes output.
Do not write production knowledge base entries before Obsidian governance approval.
Do not bypass approved-only memory governance.
Do not send full employee chat archives to an LLM prompt by default.
